run_ur5_moveit_obstacles: run the UR5 robot arm example that moves the end effector around a table obstacle using MoveIt planning
create_robot_with_moveit_planner: create a UR5 Robot instance with the ESTkConfigDefault MoveIt planner and gripper enabled
add_table_obstacle: add a table obstacle to the MoveIt planning scene using MoveitObjectHandler with a pose and size
move_ee_xyz_with_planning: move the robot arm end effector by XYZ displacement using MoveIt planning with a specified eef step
clear_planning_scene: clear all obstacles from the MoveIt planning scene using the planning scene interface
